about: Constructs of invented things, designed from real ones, for the author's visual album film. Published to view only: all rights reserved (see each folder's LICENSE); their scenes and briefs are not published.

worlds.title: ARGUS (DSV-312)
worlds.line: A 180 m deep-space survey ship laid out like NASA's nuclear-thermal transfer-ship studies: the crew at the bow, the reactor aft behind a shadow shield, the radiators inside its shadow; ISS-style truss, cupola and arrays. Lander 2 rides docked at its port.
worlds.blender: The film's Blender model of the first version, rendered in a plain studio

worlds.title: Lander 2
worlds.line: ARGUS's crewed lander: a wedge lifting body on a heat-shield belly, four folding legs, a glazed flight deck and a docking collar on its back. The ship was built around it, carrying this lander's own construct at its docking port, so the two always match.
worlds.blender: The film's Blender model, rendered in a plain studio

worlds.title: Object 001
worlds.line: An alien object, five kilometres long in the film: two porous lobes grown like the inside of a bone, almost mirrored across a pinched waist, one half slightly out of true. Nothing like it exists; it is built from structures that do.
